template.name: template_zapTab
template.event: --[[change priorities when tabs are selected to bring the selected tab to the front]] element:setOrientationPriority(-1) local palette = include("ColourPalette") element["Sprite"]:setColor(palette:getRGBFloats(palette.TAB_SPRITE_SELECTED)) element["Text"]:setColor(palette:getRGBFloats(palette.TAB_TEXT_GREEN_SELECTED))

--[[change priorities when tabs are selected to push the selected tab to the back]] element:setOrientationPriority(1) local palette = include("ColourPalette") element["Sprite"]:setColor(palette:getRGBFloats(palette.TAB_SPRITE_DESELECTED)) element["Text"]:setColor(palette:getRGBFloats(palette.TAB_TEXT_GREEN_DESELECTED))

ninesliceComponent.name: Sprite
ninesliceComponent.event: component("topHeight"):SetFloat(10.0) component("bottomHeight"):SetFloat(10.0) component("leftWidth"):SetFloat(77.0) component("rightWidth"):SetFloat(77.0) component("size"):SetFloat(0.35*game.menuScaleX()) local palette = include("ColourPalette") component:setColor(palette:getRGBFloats(palette.TAB_SPRITE_SELECTED)) component("includeBorder"):SetInt(1) component("spriteName"):SetString("gfx/menu/tab02") component("layer"):SetString("MidPopUps")

textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event: component("multiline"):SetInt(0) component("font"):Set(game.getTitleFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.25*game.hudScale()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_HCENTER_ALIGNED) component("text"):SetString(element("text"):GetString()) local palette = include("ColourPalette") component:setColor(palette:getRGBFloats(palette.TAB_TEXT_GREEN_SELECTED)) component("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(0.01) component("autoScale"):SetInt(1) component("layer"):SetString("MidPopUps")

touchComponent.name: Touch
touchComponent.event: --assumption: "filter" exists in the level above if(element:parent()("filter"):GetInt() ~= element("ID"):GetInt()) then element:parent()("filter"):SetInt(element("ID"):GetInt()) element:parent():DoStoredScript("selectNewTab") end
